payload.comment: Configuration replay stage is internally consistent and policy-compliant. No deterministic findings. Key verification points: (1) ResNet18 selected with hidden=48 controlling base width; depth=3 and all transformer-specific fields (num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers) are correctly inactive for this CNN family per pipeline policy. (2) Augmentations (hflip, rotate180, brightness) are all built-in primitives requiring no extension approval; approved_extensions being empty is consistent. (3) 28×28 RGB PathMNIST standard MedMNIST distribution confirmed (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180); augmented_train_size=359984 matches augmentation_factor=4. (4) test_metrics_used=false in both best_configuration and architecture_research; selection rule is validation-only with test locked. (5) Channel statistics (green std 0.177 vs red/blue ~0.124) are consistent with H&E asymmetry noted in research. (6) Normalization uses train-split stats only (stats_source=train, train_stats_only=true). (7) Validation accuracy 99.40% / macro-F1 99.39% are recorded as deterministic pipeline outputs. Upstream architecture_research and data_audit stages carry warning-level LLM-identified process notes (pending_review on built-in augmentation gate, null llm_model_digest, curated_excerpt retrieval mode) that are explicitly non-blocking and do not constitute deterministic findings. The compact_conv_stem_transformer pending_review status does not affect the selected resnet18 configuration. No action required; proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: Upstream architecture_research and data_audit stages carry action=revise with severity=warning; all flagged items are non-blocking LLM-identified process inconsistencies (built-in augmentation gate status, null model digest, curated excerpt retrieval) and do not constitute deterministic findings

compact_conv_stem_transformer extension remains pending_review; this does not affect the selected resnet18 configuration but should be resolved before any downstream stage attempts to instantiate that architecture

tiny_cnn is retained in architecture_priorities despite the research itself flagging it as likely to underfit; if it is ever selected in a future trial, results should be interpreted as a sanity-check baseline only
